reviews.summary: It is the one page that matches questions to where the marriage is now, shows how to ask without it feeling like an interview, and says what to do when she answers 'Fine', while the first-page lists are undifferentiated question dumps.

Every claim checks against the code and the sibling posts, the round 2 fixes are correct in both languages, and the stage table and the 'I don't know or Fine' section give advice the top results don't.

Today's first page is mostly long, undifferentiated lists, some of them sexual; this is the only one that picks questions by stage of marriage, shows how to ask, covers 'Fine', and answers every People-also-ask question, in 90 clean questions.
